_: The crown's money, the King's side of it (treasury.js reads it; what the tithe yields and the Royal Court costs each season is Freeciv's: realmrules/luadata.txt [purse]). start: the King's purse at his crowning, in gold, by the reign's wealth. wear: each time the King buys the same thing within wear.seasons, its price rises by wear.step of the base. thin: below this the treasury is thin (one big thing's worth) and the court may hear of it. tithe.start: a new realm's tithe; step: how far one 'raise' or 'lower' moves it; max: the highest the King may set; high: the houses grumble at or above it (and the ledger names a heavy hand); low: at or below it the ledger names a light hand; wear: favour each house loses a season per whole tithe (at 0.1, 0.4 a season). tithe.changeEvery: seasons between two changes of the tithe (4 = once a year; the top bar says when it may change again; gameplay review #3: it was a free slider, 0 to 40% in two calls). marketGold: gold the crown gets each season per Marketplace in its towns on top of Freeciv's own tax (0: none; it was 40, gold from nothing; a house's gold comes from what its land yields, gold seams most of all: data/mines.json). workSeasons: seasons the King's own works take to rise (treasury.js).
